Translations.MAJTEXT_LIST_INPUT_HINT: Press Select P1 (or touch secondary screen) to search and sort songs, long press to refresh the song list. Touch the song cover for random selection. Long press Button 4 to start practice mode. Long press Button 5 to logout. Press Alt+Enter to toggle full-screen mode. Press Alt+F4 to exit the game.
Translations.MAJTEXT_LIST_EMPTY_COLLECTION: Oops... This collection is empty or contains no matching charts
Translations.MAJSETTING_PROPERTY_AnswerOffset_DESC: Adjust the timing of the guide sound without affecting judgment. Decrease if the guide sound plays too late; increase if too early. Do not adjust this unless you know what you are doing.
Translations.MAJSETTING_PROPERTY_Answer_DESC: Volume of chart guide sounds and the intro metronome
Translations.MAJSETTING_PROPERTY_AudioOffset_DESC: Move the chart to align to the music. FAST = Negative (-); LATE = Positive (+), in seconds.
Translations.MAJSETTING_PROPERTY_AutoPlay_DESC: XXLB will help you play the chart
Translations.MAJSETTING_PROPERTY_BGInfo_DESC: Choose what information is displayed at the center during gameplay
Translations.MAJSETTING_PROPERTY_BGM_DESC: Background music in song select, result, and other non-gameplay scenes
Translations.MAJSETTING_PROPERTY_BackgroundDim_DESC: Adjust the brightness of the background during gameplay. Higher values are darker.
Translations.MAJSETTING_PROPERTY_BreakFastLateType_DE: Set which judgment levels show Fast/Late on Break Notes. Higher judgments are hidden.
Translations.MAJSETTING_PROPERTY_BreakJudgeType_DESC: Set which judgment levels are shown for Break Notes. Higher judgments are hidden.
Translations.MAJSETTING_PROPERTY_ButtonRingForTouch_D: Handle Slide and Touch inputs with Buttons
Translations.MAJSETTING_PROPERTY_DJAutoPolicy_DESC: Strict: Only allows either buttons or touchscreen, not both. Lax: Allows switching between buttons and touchscreen during play.
Translations.MAJSETTING_PROPERTY_DisableGCInGameing_D: Disables garbage collection during gameplay, which may reduce audio stuttering
Translations.MAJSETTING_PROPERTY_DisableVideoBG_DESC: When enabled, background videos will not be displayed
Translations.MAJSETTING_PROPERTY_DisplayBreakScore_DE: Display Break Note score on judgment (BREAK 2550, instead of Perfect).
Translations.MAJSETTING_PROPERTY_DisplayCriticalPerfe: Display Critical Perfect judgments during gameplay
Translations.MAJSETTING_PROPERTY_DisplayRuntimeInfo_D: Display FPS and version at the top-right of the sub-screen
Translations.MAJSETTING_PROPERTY_DisplayHoldHeadJudge: Show the judgment result for the head of Hold Notes
Translations.MAJSETTING_PROPERTY_DisplayOffset_DESC: Compensate for frame delay. Do not adjust this unless you know what it does.
Translations.MAJSETTING_PROPERTY_Ex_DESC: Sound upon non-Miss judgment on an EX Tap/Hold
Translations.MAJSETTING_PROPERTY_FPSLimit_DESC: Limit the maximum FPS of the game
Translations.MAJSETTING_PROPERTY_FastLateType_DESC: Set which judgment levels show Fast/Late. Higher judgments are hidden.
Translations.MAJSETTING_PROPERTY_FastPractice_DESC: Enable pressing 1+2+7+8 during gameplay to enter practice mode menu. Start/End time: -5s / Hold / +10s.
Translations.MAJSETTING_PROPERTY_GameplayScreenRotati: Adjust the screen display orientation during gameplay
Translations.MAJSETTING_PROPERTY_GameplaySubScreenCli: Set what happens when tapping the sub-screen during gameplay
Translations.MAJSETTING_PROPERTY_Hanabi_DESC: Firework sound played by Touch Hanabi effects
Translations.MAJSETTING_PROPERTY_InnerJudgeDistance_D: Adjust where judgments from Touch Notes appear. Lower is towards the center.
Translations.MAJSETTING_PROPERTY_JudgeOffset_DESC: Move the timing window. FAST = Negative (-); LATE = Positive (+), in seconds.
Translations.MAJSETTING_PROPERTY_JudgeStyle_DESC: Adjust how strict the judgment windows are
Translations.MAJSETTING_PROPERTY_LeadInTime_DESC: The wait time after entering the gameplay screen and before the game officially starts
Translations.MAJSETTING_PROPERTY_MainScreenPosition_D: Adjust the main screen's horizontal position
Translations.MAJSETTING_PROPERTY_Mirror_DESC: Flip the chart by an axis
Translations.MAJSETTING_PROPERTY_Mode_DESC: Change how Hold and Slide judgments behave (Classic / DX judgment).
Translations.MAJSETTING_PROPERTY_NoteAppearRate_DESC: Adjust the fade-in behavior of Tap, Hold, and Star Notes
Translations.MAJSETTING_PROPERTY_NoteJudgeType_DESC: Set which judgment levels are shown for Tap/Hold. Higher judgments are hidden.
Translations.MAJSETTING_PROPERTY_NoteMask_DESC: Apply a mask that covers a portion of the gameplay screen
Translations.MAJSETTING_PROPERTY_OffsetUnit_DESC: Change the unit used for all offset settings
Translations.MAJSETTING_PROPERTY_OuterJudgeDistance_D: Adjust where judgments from the ring appear. Lower is towards the center.
Translations.MAJSETTING_PROPERTY_PlaybackSpeed_DESC: Adjust the playback speed of the track
Translations.MAJSETTING_PROPERTY_RenderScale_DESC: Adjust the internal rendering resolution. 100% uses full resolution. Lower values reduce GPU load but soften graphics and text, without changing layout or judgment.
Translations.MAJSETTING_PROPERTY_Rotation_DESC: Rotate the chart in 45-degree increments (one button). Positive is clockwise; negative is counterclockwise.
Translations.MAJSETTING_PROPERTY_SecondaryBGInfo_DESC: Choose what information is displayed below center during gameplay
Translations.MAJSETTING_PROPERTY_Skin_DESC: Change the Note skin used during gameplay
Translations.MAJSETTING_PROPERTY_SkipVideoDownload_DE: When loading online charts, skip downloading the video
Translations.MAJSETTING_PROPERTY_SlideFadeInOffset_DE: Adjust the appearance timing of Slide paths. Positive values are later.
Translations.MAJSETTING_PROPERTY_SlideJudgeType_DESC: Set which judgment levels are shown for Slides. Higher judgments are hidden.
Translations.MAJSETTING_PROPERTY_SlideNoHead_DESC: Remove the head Tap from all Slides
Translations.MAJSETTING_PROPERTY_SlideNoTrack_DESC: Remove the body of all Slides
Translations.MAJSETTING_PROPERTY_SlideScale_DESC: Adjust Slide size during gameplay. Does not affect Wi-Fi Slides.
Translations.MAJSETTING_PROPERTY_SlideSkipping_DESC: Enable or disable the Slide section-skipping mechanic
Translations.MAJSETTING_PROPERTY_SlideSortOrder_DESC: Classic: New Slides on top. Modern: Old Slides on top.
Translations.MAJSETTING_PROPERTY_StarRotation_DESC: Toggle rotating Stars when approaching the ring
Translations.MAJSETTING_PROPERTY_SubScreenBGInfo_DESC: Choose what information is displayed on the sub-screen
Translations.MAJSETTING_PROPERTY_SubdivideSlideJudgeG: Allow non-Critical Perfect judgments on Slides
Translations.MAJSETTING_PROPERTY_TapSpeed_DESC: Adjust how fast Notes approach the ring
Translations.MAJSETTING_PROPERTY_TopInfo_DESC: Information displayed on the bar between Buttons 1 and 8
Translations.MAJSETTING_PROPERTY_Topmost_DESC: Keep the MajdataPlay window always on top
Translations.MAJSETTING_PROPERTY_TouchFeedback_DESC: Change where the reaction effect is displayed when you touch the screen
Translations.MAJSETTING_PROPERTY_TouchJudgeType_DESC: Set which judgment levels are shown for Touch Notes. Higher judgments are hidden.
Translations.MAJSETTING_PROPERTY_TouchRadiusAdjust_DE: Increase the effective touch area. Higher values make the touch area larger.
Translations.MAJSETTING_PROPERTY_TouchSpeed_DESC: Adjust how fast Touch Notes appear and close in
Translations.MAJSETTING_PROPERTY_TrackSkip_DESC: Hold Buttons 2, 3, 6, and 7 to skip the track
Translations.MAJSETTING_PROPERTY_EnforceGameFailure_D: When enabled, automatically skip or retry the track if the target achievement is no longer reachable
Translations.MAJSETTING_PROPERTY_TryFixAudioSync_DESC: When audio stuttering occurs, attempt to resync Notes with the audio timeline

Translations.MAJSETTING_PROPERTY_MainScreenOffset_DES: Adjusts the position of the main gameplay screen on your display. Use this to fine-tune alignment.
Translations.MAJSETTING_PROPERTY_MainScreenScale_DESC: Adjusts the overall size of the main gameplay screen. Higher values make the screen larger.
Translations.MAJSETTING_PROPERTY_MainScreenTransform_: When enabled, allows manual adjustment of the main screen ratio and position. When disabled, the default display ratio is used.
Translations.MAJSETTING_PROPERTY_RecordMode_DESC: Disable: Recording disabled. OBS: Uses an OBS WebSocket server to automatically control start and stop recording. Enable the OBS WebSocket service under Tools -> WebSocket Server and disable authentication.
Translations.MAJSETTING_PROPERTY_SubDisplayOffset_DES: Adjusts the position of the secondary display area on the screen
Translations.MAJSETTING_PROPERTY_SubDisplayScale_DESC: Adjusts the size of the secondary display area. Higher values make it larger.
Translations.MAJSETTING_PROPERTY_TouchAAreaExtraRadiu: Adds extra radius to the A area. Higher values make it easier to trigger the A sensor group.
Translations.MAJSETTING_PROPERTY_TouchBAreaExtraRadiu: Adds extra radius to the B area. Higher values make it easier to trigger the B sensor group.
Translations.MAJSETTING_PROPERTY_TouchCAreaExtraRadiu: Adds extra radius to the C area. Higher values make it easier to trigger the C sensor group.
Translations.MAJSETTING_PROPERTY_TouchDAreaExtraRadiu: Adds extra radius to the D area. Higher values make it easier to trigger the D sensor group.
Translations.MAJSETTING_PROPERTY_TouchEAreaExtraRadiu: Adds extra radius to the E area. Higher values make it easier to trigger the E sensor group.
Translations.MAJSETTING_PROPERTY_TouchPanelOffset_DES: Adjust this if you feel input latency on the inner touch panel. Move left if you get too many Fast hits; move right if you get too many Late hits.
Translations.MAJSETTING_PROPERTY_TouchSimulationRadiu: Effective for touchscreens. Higher values simulate a larger finger size.
Translations.MAJSETTING_PROPERTY_TrackVolumeOffset_DE: Adjusts the music playback volume offset
Translations.MAJSETTING_PROPERTY_Track_DESC: Main music track volume during gameplay
Translations.MAJTEXT_ERR_VIDEO_PLAYER_PREPARE_TIMEOUT: Video loading timed out. The song cover will be used as the background.
Translations.MAJSETTING_PROPERTY_EnableJudgeTimingGau: Show real-time timing offsets and the average judgment position
Translations.MAJSETTING_PROPERTY_ManualStartGame_DESC: Wait for a button press after loading before starting gameplay (for tournaments)
Translations.MAJTEXT_ONLINE_MACHINE_REGISTRATION_UNSU: The server does not support device registration
